campi_del_mandato.environmental_conditions: Soil temperature 1-27 degC at 30 cm. Volumetric moisture measured hourly but published only as a figure.
campi_del_mandato.instrument: Automatic accumulation chamber to ISO 11665-7, two 6-hour cycles per day; HPGe gamma spectrometry in an underground laboratory for Ra-226
campi_del_mandato.licence: SSRN open preprint; journal version DOI to be reconfirmed on the publisher page (Crossref gives 10.1016/j.jenvrad.2026.107958)
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: Field moisture is the one missing input: recovered as a window Sw 0.24-0.53 by inverting the published diffusion length.
campi_del_mandato.site: Bratislava, FMPI Comenius University campus, sandy-silt ranker soil
campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: Ra-226 28.0+-0.3, Ra-228 25.9+-0.5 Bq/kg; total porosity 0.459; dry bulk density 1430 kg/m3; texture published
campi_del_mandato.split: Field validation. No row enters calibration.
campi_del_mandato.timestamp: October 2020 to June 2024, almost four years continuous
campi_del_mandato.units: Ra-226 Bq/kg; flux mBq/m2/s; porosity and saturation dimensionless; density kg/m3; temperature degC

note: Independent flux at the same campus from Holy et al. 2016 (15.0+-1.8 mBq/m2/s, summer, chamber) is a cross-check but is a summer value and the authors warn summer rates run about twice the annual mean.
